items.title: France orders evacuation of tourist spot as hundreds flee wildfires by boat

items.title: US hits dozens of countries with new wave of tariffs
items.description: Imposed citing forced labour concerns, the levies replace a temporary global duty brought in after the US Supreme Court struck down tariffs in February.

items.title: Oil prices hit $100 for the first time since May
items.description: The price of Brent crude rose more than 6% on Thursday as the war in the Middle East continues to escalate.

items.title: Indonesian babies were trafficked to Singapore. What happens to them now?
items.description: At least 12 babies have been trafficked from Indonesia to Singapore, but what will happen to them remains unclear.

items.description: The divorce, involving the chairman of one of South Korea's biggest companies, has gripped the nation.

items.description: The US president says the landmark agreement to help Saudis develop nuclear energy is dependent on it joining the Abraham Accords.

items.title: India's 'cockroach' protesters and government to hold talks as stalemate continues
items.description: The meeting comes hours after activist Sonam Wangchuk announced he was ending his 26-day hunger strike.

items.title: Teen jailed for exam cheating in Guinea dies after sickle cell complications, father says
items.description: Mamadou Djouma Bah, 17, was arrested and sentenced to prison for exam fraud earlier this month.

items.description: Mykhailo Fedorov refuses President Zelensky's offer to accept an alternative post, as the battle of wills continues.

items.title: 'Let's enjoy the ride' says Elon Musk, as AI fears mount
items.description: Talking to The Economist, Musk said he doesn't care if people hate him and said he was not a racist.

items.title: Nicaragua's legislature debates barring opposition from elections
items.description: The move comes days after President Daniel Ortega demanded 'a wall, a blockade' against opposition parties.

items.title: Ex-governor convicted of murdering a pregnant student in Kenya
